name: Matjaž Nemec-§ 2-Am 11
title: REPORT on Parliament’s estimates of revenue and expenditure for the financial year 2026
part_text: 2. Deplores the agreement reached in the Conciliation between the Bureau and the Committee on Budgets on 18 March 2025 to set an increase of 4,09% in the 2026 budget compared to the 2025 budget, corresponding to an overall of estimates of EUR 2 636 241 620 for 2026; notes with dismay that the Conciliation has only resulted in negligible net savings amounting to EUR 5,368,000, representing merely 0,2% of the budget, which is clearly not commensurate with the stakes involved;
